channel.title: Screen Time Math
channel.description:
One-minute episodes that do the maths on everyday screen time, with no shame, plus one small way to win back a few minutes. Good for families and anyone curious about their phone habits.

Made by Honest Little Apps, the makers of Time Debt: Screen Time, an iPhone app where borrowing extra screen time today means a shorter allowance tomorrow. Time Debt: Screen Time on the App Store

Narrated with a synthetic (text-to-speech) voice.
